title: STAY CLEAR! Premium suddenly revoked
body:
EDIT: after reading more recent reviews, apparently I'm not the only one who got screwed over. What a*****e business practice. STAY CLEAR!

I've been using the app for about 4 months now. I especially liked the widget for quick updates, which is why I had paid for the app.
A few days ago, after an update, i suddenly lost the premium features - I can no longer use the widget (and also dark mode was switched back to light mode). The Redeem Purchase option also didn't help.

I tried contacting the app support both via email and via Instagram (these are the options they give), and also attached a screenshot of the purchase receipt, but got no response.

So this is my last resort trying to get noticed and have this fixed. I enjoyed using the app, and hope this is some kind of glitch that can be fixed, not a deliberate change to the payment options that disregards existing users and nullifies previous purchases
